clips.send: Line. A mark that moves through space — the first thing you ever drew. Horizontal lines feel calm, vertical lines feel strong, diagonal and zigzag lines feel fast. Lines can be implied: your eye “draws” a line where someone is looking. Chinese calligraphy is the art of line — thick, thin, fast, dry. Line equals a dot that went for a walk (Paul Klee).

clips.send: 线条。在空间中移动的痕迹——你画的第一笔就是线。 水平线安静，垂直线有力量，斜线和折线有速度感。 线也可以是“暗示”的：人物的目光方向会让眼睛自动连成一条线。 中国书法就是线条的艺术——粗细、快慢、干湿。 线是“出去散步的点”（克利）。
